issue.title: Bug: sonic-mgmt bgp testcase failures when we have sonic as neighbor devices

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

The BGP testcases are written assumption of Arista EOS as neighbor devices.  The following test cases fail, when we use sonic as neighbor devices as well.

/tests/bgp/test_bgp_peer_shutdown.py
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_route_neigh_learning.py
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_bbr.py
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_allow_list.py

### Steps to Reproduce

Try to run the above mentioned testcases using sonic as neighbor devices.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

all testcases should pass without any error

resolution.title: BGP testcases failure having sonic as neighbor device
resolution.description:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22578

The following are a set of testcase which fail when we use sonic as neighbor device.  This set of testcases use EOS as neighbor device.

List of test cases:
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_peer_shutdown.py
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_route_neigh_learning.py
/tests/bgp/test_bgp_bbr.py

The changes include some of the common and helper function update to support sonic related configuration and validaton and using these in these test cases.
